name: Ant Size
description: In a kitchen the subject shrinks to the size of a coin and the world becomes gigantic.

wardrobe.man: an orange hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers
wardrobe.woman: an orange hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers
wardrobe.person: an orange hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands on the wooden floor of a bright modern kitchen in the morning, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}. A kitchen island with stools behind {them}, a fridge on the left, a few coffee beans and a dropped spoon on the floor near {their} feet, and sunlight pouring in through a large window. Medium-wide shot at a low angle from floor height, the {subject} centered, full body visible. Cinematic photography, warm morning sun from the window on the right, soft shadows. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain unbranded appliances throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided first image as the first frame and the provided last image as the last frame. The camera stays locked at floor level and completely still for the whole shot. The {subject} stands upright in the same spot for the whole shot, legs straight, eyes on a point just past the camera, and {their} whole body shrinks smoothly and evenly from full size down to the tiny figure of the last frame, while the kitchen and every object in it keep exactly the same size. SCALE LAW: the {subject} shrinks as a standing figure; a crouching, kneeling or sitting pose = failed take. Sound: a quick descending whoosh, the room sound turning huge and slow, a deep distant fridge hum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, macro photography scale with shallow depth of field, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame shrinks quickly and smoothly, the clothes shrinking with {them}, until by the last second the figure is the size of a coin and every object around {them} towers like a giant building, {their} face still recognisable. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a quick descending whoosh, the surrounding sound turning huge and slow. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, macro photography scale with shallow depth of field, sharp detail, stable picture.
last_frame_prompt: Shrink the {subject} in image 1 to the size of an ant, about one centimetre tall, standing upright on the wooden floor right beside the coffee beans, so a single coffee bean is bigger than {their} whole body and the spoon lies beside {them} like a giant metal bridge. The space where the {subject} stood becomes empty kitchen floor with the island and the stools behind it. Keep the kitchen, the camera position, the framing, the light and every object exactly the same size and in the same place. The tiny {subject} keeps the same face, hair, orange hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers. Photorealistic macro detail, sharp focus on the tiny {subject} and the coffee beans.
